Generators, analyzers, and calculators for funnel builders, course creators, and email marketers. Every tool runs in your browser, takes under a minute, and is free forever.

/
01
AI & CONTENT
· 2 TOOLS
AI & content

Tools that turn a 30-second brief into a tailored prompt, headline, persona, or topic list. Built around your own brand inputs.

AI Prompt Generator

A tailored AI prompt for any systeme.io page in 30 seconds. Paste into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini.

Raw HTML Converter

Paste any HTML, get a version that drops cleanly into systeme.io's Raw HTML element. Caps z-index, strips wrappers, fixes universal selectors.

02
EMAIL & DELIVERABILITY
· 2 TOOLS
Email & deliverability

Practical utilities for the highest-ROI channel small businesses have: signature, subject line, and inbox placement.

Email Signature Generator

A polished signature with photo, role, and social links. Paste into Gmail, Outlook, or Apple Mail.

Domain Health Checker

DMARC, SPF, DKIM, MX, A, CNAME, and NS in one report. Plain-English fix for whatever's broken.

03
LANDING PAGES & SEO
· 5 TOOLS
Landing pages & SEO

Quick checks that catch the obvious mistakes before you ship. CRO scoring, search-result previews, and JSON-LD output.

Landing Page Analyzer

Paste your hero copy and CTA. Get a CRO score with prioritized fixes from 30+ landing page principles.

Meta Tag Preview

Render your page title and meta description as a Google search result while you type.

FAQ Schema Generator

Turn 4-8 question and answer pairs into FAQPage JSON-LD ready to paste into your page header.

Robots.txt Generator

Build a robots.txt file with rules for user-agents, sitemap paths, and allow/disallow patterns.

Word Counter

Word and character count, Flesch-Kincaid readability, Gunning Fog score, and keyword density.

04
CALCULATORS
· 11 TOOLS
Calculators

Plug real numbers in, get real outcomes out. ROI projections, pricing ranges, and funnel-stack economics for your offer.

Funnel Stack Pricing

Optimize tripwire, order bump, upsell, and downsell prices around your main offer to maximize average order value.

Funnel ROI Calculator

Traffic, conversion rate, and AOV in. Revenue, cost per acquisition, and break-even traffic out.

Course Pricing Calculator

A recommended price range based on length, audience size, niche, and competitor pricing.

Email Marketing ROI

List size, open rate, CTR, conversion, AOV in. Revenue, profit, and ROI per dollar out.

CAC / LTV / Payback

Customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, LTV:CAC ratio, and payback months in one view.

Break-Even Calculator

Fixed cost, variable cost, and price per unit in. Units to break even and revenue target out.

A/B Test Calculator

Sample size needed for a test, plus statistical significance for results once it ends.

Conversion Rate

Visitors and conversions in. Conversion rate out, with benchmarks for each funnel stage.

Webinar Attendance

Registrations, attendees, and offer takers in. Show-up rate, close rate, and revenue out.

Profit Margin

Five modes: gross, net, markup, margin from price, or price from a target margin.

Affiliate Commission

Clicks, conversion rate, commission, and price in. Earnings per click, total, and monthly projection out.

05
UTILITIES
· 4 TOOLS
Utilities

Small utilities you reach for every week. Trackable campaign links and scannable codes for anything that lives in print.

UTM Builder

Build trackable campaign URLs with source, medium, campaign, content, and term parameters.

QR Code Generator

Turn any URL into a QR code. Customize size, color, and corner style. Download as PNG or SVG.

Password Generator

A strong, random password of any length. Configurable character mix, browser-only.

Lorem Ipsum Generator

Placeholder text for funnel mockups and design drafts. Paragraphs, sentences, words, or list items.

THE FULL STACK
The same toolkit, inside one platform.

Funnels, courses, emails, automation, affiliate programs, and payments. systeme.io is free to start with 2,000 contacts and three funnels at $0.
